home.title: Find free food near you
home.lead: Food pantries, free meals, and delivery programs in Northern Virginia. We show what is confirmed and clearly mark what is not.
home.typesTitle: Kinds of help you can find

pantry.title: Food pantries
pantry.body: Pick up groceries such as canned goods, rice, fresh produce, or dairy to cook at home.

meals.title: Free meals
meals.body: Community kitchens and churches that serve a hot meal, often with no questions asked.

delivery.title: Home delivery
delivery.body: Programs that bring food to people who cannot travel, such as older adults or people with disabilities.

mobile.title: Mobile pantries
mobile.body: Trucks that hand out food at schools, parks, and community centers on certain days.

other.title: Other help
other.body: Baby formula, diapers, hygiene items, grocery vouchers, and referrals to other programs.

home.legendLead: Every requirement, like needing an ID, is shown one of three ways:

legend.not_required: The organization confirmed you do not need this.
legend.required: The organization says you need this.
legend.unknown: We do not know yet. Call before you go. It does not mean there is no requirement.

about.title: About this site
about.lead: A free public directory of food assistance in Northern Virginia, built so that families can trust what they read.
about.what: We collect information about food pantries, free meals, delivery programs, and related help from public sources and from the organizations themselves. A person reviews each listing before it is published. We show what is confirmed, and we clearly say when something is not.
about.sourcesIntro: These are the sources we currently use:
about.labelVerified: A reviewer confirmed the listing in the last {{days}} days.
about.labelStale: The listing has not been confirmed recently. Details may be out of date.
about.labelSynthetic: Fictional test data used to check the site. It is not a real place.
about.review: We aim to re-check every listing at least every {{days}} days. Listings that have not been re-checked are marked “Needs re-check”.
about.changes: Food banks depend on donations and volunteers. Hours, food types, and stock can change from week to week, and some events are cancelled at short notice. We never show current stock because no organization reports it to us in real time.
about.contact: Always call or check the organization's website before you travel. They have the most up-to-date information, and they can tell you what to bring.
about.disclaimer: This site is provided for information only. We are not affiliated with the organizations listed and cannot guarantee that help will be available. If you have an emergency, call 911. For other help, you can call 211.
about.privacy1: There are no ads, trackers, or analytics on this site.
about.privacy2: If you use “Use my location”, your location is used only for that search in your browser and is never stored.
about.privacy3: You do not need an account. If you create one, we store only your email, password (hashed), language, saved places, and search preferences.
about.privacy4: Your language choice is remembered on this device only.
